items.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
items.summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.
